data.name: Jarrad
data.short_meaning: Descender, or the one who is lowered
data.long_meaning: The name Jarrad originated from Jared in Hebrew, which means 'descender' or 'the one who is lowered'. In the Bible, Jared is listed as the father of Enoch, the seventh patriarch in the line of Adam. This name is a powerful reminder of humility and submission to God's will.

Jarrad is a powerful name that inspires us to remain humble, obedient, and steadfast in our faith.
